title.narrative: Provision of life saving essential health services to most vulnerable population with ongoing humanitarian crisis

description.narrative: The main objective of this UNFPA project is to provide integrated sexual and reproductive health services, gender-based violence response, and mental health and psychosocial support for women, girls, and other vulnerable groups in the Southeast, Northwest, and Northeast of Myanmar. This project supports access to a priority package of SRHR services through mobile and static clinics, as well as GBV response services, including case management and psychosocial support. Additionally, the project procures and distributes clean delivery kits (CDK) and dignity kits, ensuring comprehensive maternal and reproductive health support. This project provides life-saving assistance to 30,120 people, of whom 25,521 women, 2,323 men and 2,276 children. Additionally, 2,108 people with disabilities benefit from this project.
